description.zh: 这是一个设有装配线、储物柜、纸箱和座椅的工厂车间。你可以沿通道步行探索，靠近设备并从不同角度观察。
description.en: A factory hall with an assembly line, lockers, boxes and chairs. Walk along the aisle, approach the equipment and inspect it from different viewpoints.

description.zh: 这是一个设有测试设备、轨道、防撞设施和金属桶的车辆测试与装卸区。你可以沿通道行走，改变观察距离和视角来检查周围物体。
description.en: A vehicle testing and loading area with test equipment, rails, bumpers and metal drums. Walk along the aisle and vary your distance and viewpoint to inspect the objects.

description.zh: 这是一个能俯瞰车间的工厂控制室，设有座椅、茶几和杂志。你可以在室内行走并靠近家具观察。
description.en: A factory control room overlooking the workshop, furnished with chairs, a coffee table and magazines. Walk around the room and approach the furniture to inspect it.
